question: What is the total value of the 'Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool' (BMIP) launched by the Ministry of Finance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**USD 1.5 billion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Department of Financial Services (DFS)** under the **Ministry of Finance** has launched the **'Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool' (BMIP)**.
 
• The pool aims to provide continuous maritime insurance coverage amid current **Middle East tensions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pool Size:** The total value of the newly launched **Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP)** is **USD 1.5 billion**. Therefore, option 4 is correct.
 
• **Sovereign Guarantee:** The pool is backed by a sovereign guarantee of **USD 1.4 billion (₹12,980 crores)** from the government to act as a safety net.
 
• **Administration:** **GIC Re** serves as the pool administrator and will submit returns, details of reinsurance arrangements, and performance statements.
 
• **First Policy Issued:** The first **Marine Hull & Machinery War Policy** document under BMIP was handed over to **M/s. Hoger Offshore and Marine Private Limited**, issued by **The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Coverage Details:** The pool covers all maritime risks, including **Hull and Machinery, Cargo, P&I (Protection and Indemnity), and War risks**.
 
• **Target Audience:** The insurance is designated for Indian-flagged or controlled vessels, or vessels destined to or originating from **India**.
 
• **Claim Servicing:** For claims up to **USD 100 million**, the pool will use its own capacity. The sovereign guarantee will only be invoked for claims exceeding this amount, acting as a contingent backstop of last resort.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The initiative will strengthen **India’s sovereign control over maritime trade** and ensure trade continuity despite potential withdrawals of international insurance due to geopolitical tensions or sanctions.
 
• This mechanism ultimately strengthens India's maritime risk protection framework and promotes the nation's financial sovereignty on the global stage.
